title: Jude
author: Jude, servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James.
historicalSetting: Jude urges believers to contend for the faith and remain in God's love.
keyVerse: Jude 1:3 — "Contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints."
christFocus: Jude points to Christ as the only Master and Lord, the One who keeps His people and presents them faultless with joy.
outline: Call to perseverance and mercy — Jude 17-23
